### When the Painful Date Becomes a Testimony
Author: Lynn Cowell
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-september-11-2026.html
Passage: Psalm 27:13-14
Points:
- Painful memories and seasons of betrayal can deeply shake our sense of security.
- Like David facing adversity, believers can choose confident trust over fear.
- Intentionally dwelling in God's presence, gazing on His majesty, and seeking Him brings peace.
- Patiently waiting on the Lord restores courage and reveals His goodness in the land of the living.

### Rejected by Family Accepted by God
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/rejected-by-family-accepted-by-god.html
Passage: Psalm 27:10
Points:
- Human family relationships can be fraught with rejection, misunderstanding, and estrangement.
- Even if earthly parents forsake or fail us, the Lord unconditionally welcomes and receives us.
- A believer's core identity rests on adoption into God's eternal family rather than earthly approval.
- Bringing emotional wounds honestly to God allows His enduring love to bring comfort and healing.

### On a Journey toward the Master
Author: Leslie Snyder
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/homeword-sept-11-2007-11553750.html
Passage: Psalm 27:4
Points:
- Seeking God deeply often requires setting aside everyday comforts and digital distractions.
- A genuine pilgrimage of the soul involves moving beyond routine to focus wholly on the Lord.
- The greatest desire of the faithful heart is to dwell with God and behold His beauty.
- Stepping away from noise to seek God diligently yields profound spiritual renewal.

### The Secret Place
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/day-by-day-dec-10-2010-11642464.html
Passage: Psalm 27:8
Points:
- Urgent demands and active Christian ministry can easily crowd out solitary communion with God.
- True prayer prioritizes seeking the Lord's face rather than merely accomplishing tasks.
- Spending time alone with God brings clear direction, spiritual reassurance, and conviction of sin.
- Solitary, secret prayer before the Father is where a believer's most important work is accomplished.
